objective: Rebuild peer messaging greenfield so HTTP transport carries Double-Ratchet confidentiality and interlocutor trust via safety numbers and verification pinning.
non_goals: No TLS/HTTPS requirement (cleartext HTTP transport remains allowed)
No multi-device key sync or password recovery
No group chat or multi-peer mesh
No persistent encrypted disk store beyond in-process trusted-contact pins
grill: User priority: confidentiality of exchanges and trust in the interlocutor; HTTP must keep working; greenfield so legacy ECDH SessionKeys may be deleted.
Assumed Noise-style authenticated handshake (static+ephemeral DH) seeds a Signal Double Ratchet; AES-256-GCM remains the AEAD.
Assumed safety numbers from sorted identity public keys plus an explicit verify/pin action; unverified sessions still encrypt but surface untrusted state.
Rejected mandatory HTTPS for this slice: confidentiality is end-to-end at the application layer; transport may stay http://.

Pre-mortem: most plausible failure is a TOFU MITM on first HTTP connect before out-of-band verify — mitigate by binding listen_url into the handshake transcript, showing safety numbers prominently, and refusing to treat unverified peers as trusted.

risk.rationale: New session crypto, interlocutor authentication/trust pinning, HTTP input parsing, and concurrent send/poll ratchets.

acceptance.criterion: Two peers encrypt/decrypt through a Double Ratchet with forward-moving chain keys; tampered ciphertext is rejected.
Safety numbers are deterministic for a key pair; verify pins the peer; a different identity key is not treated as verified.
Two HTTP peers complete authenticated handshake, exchange ratchet messages, and mailbox pull still works for NAT.
Tauri backend compiles with trust commands linked.

execution.rationale: Crypto, peer wire format, and UI trust surface share one integration path.

tasks.outcome: Replace session crypto with authenticated handshake, Double Ratchet, safety numbers, and trust pins.
Wire HTTP peer protocol to the new handshake/ratchet payloads and trust APIs.
Show safety number and verified/untrusted state; add verify contact action.
Evidence, independent review, and GraphPact done state.

findings: Pull auth uses timestamped single-use nonces; replay rejected.
send_text requires Verified trust after safety-number pin.
trust_state recomputes safety_number against the pinned contact.
Residual accepted: TOFU until explicit verify; receive allowed while unverified.
